source.text: A stress limit the case states for the fuel (a flat strength of 1 GPa, a synthetic figure) against the largest von Mises stress, which for this state is |sigma_z| = E alpha (hottest cell rise): margin 1 GPa minus 600.74 MPa. The check is the smallest margin over the fuel's cells.
source.check: FEED's real-solver test (tests/mechanicsSolver.test.ts, plane strain) reproduces sigma_z = -E alpha dT to 0.5 %. The margin is the check 'stressLimit:<name>' of FEED's result.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin at 10 W/m in a 600 K coolant, both solids linear elastic (E 200 GPa, nu 0.3) stress-free at 300 K, constant conductivities; thermo-elastic, small strain, no creep, plasticity or swelling; axially fixed, one fuel stress limit with a flat strength
